title: dead/ subdir not created: move_to_dead_letter silently fails
description: SmtpRelayQueue::new (and NntpQueue::new) create queue_dir but not dead/. move_to_dead_letter calls tokio::fs::rename to dead/<name>; on Linux rename(2) returns ENOENT if the target directory is absent. The failure is warned but the file stays in the queue. Trigger: first DKIM failure or permanent 5xx on a fresh queue dir — dead/ never exists at startup. Bad behavior: message loops in the queue indefinitely, re-attempting delivery (DKIM fails again every cycle) or re-hitting the peer that rejected it.
